sections.heading: Mac mini and the Environment
sections.source_text: See the Mac mini Product En­viron­men­tal Report (PDF)

sections.heading: Progress towards Apple 2030
sections.source_text:
Apple 2030 is our goal to be carbon neutral across our value chain. We design our products to be less carbon intensive by prioritising the use of recycled and renewable content and low‑carbon materials while focusing on the energy efficiency of our software and hardware.
See Apple’s commitment

sections.heading: Materials
sections.source_text:
Mac mini is made with 50% recycled content, 7 including:
100% recycled aluminium in the enclosure and thermal module stage
100% recycled copper in multiple thermal module components
100% recycled copper plating in all Apple‑designed printed circuit boards
100% recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple‑designed printed circuit boards
80% recycled steel in multiple components including the logo and fan pillow

sections.heading: Energy
sections.source_text:
100% of manufacturing electricity for Mac mini is sourced from renewable electricity 9
100% of expected customer use electricity matched with low‑carbon electricity 10
ENERGY STAR® certified 11

sections.heading: Smarter chemistry 12
sections.source_text: All the materials used in Apple products, accessories and packaging are covered by the requirements of our Regulated Substances Specification , which was one of the first in industry to restrict the use of key substances of concern. See the latest En­viron­men­tal Progress Report to understand Apple’s recent efforts in phasing out these chemistries.
